purpose: A search-and-pick box for records: debounced search, grouped hits, "nothing found", an incomplete-answer note with Try again, and mouse picking; the caller decides what is searched.
namedChanges: The default `find` is removed (the source's lines 138-140 and 146 chose between the caller's `find` and `findOrganizationRecords` of the app's organization card): `find` is required in the props type; the default key `defaultKey` is the source's `find` branch alone, `["record-picker", findKey ?? label, vaultId, debounced]`; the `queryFn` is `find(debounced)`. For a caller who passes `find` (every caller of this unit) nothing differs.

`useQuery` (lines 144-150: `queryKey`, `queryFn`, `enabled`, `staleTime`, `retry: false`) is a call to the host hook from `PickerQueryContext` with `{ key, run, enabled, staleTime }`, the same values; `retry: false` is the host hook's to pass. A missing provider throws. New exports `PickerQueryArgs`, `PickerQueryResult`, `UsePickerQuery`, `PickerQueryContext`. The result fields the component reads are `data`, `isFetching`, `isError`, `isSuccess`.
`OrgRecordHit` is imported from `./types`; the `@tanstack/react-query` and `orgRecords` imports are removed.
One new line at the end: `export const RecordPicker = OrgRecordPicker;`.

library.title: Record picker (search and pick)
library.note: The caller decides what is searched; for a GilbVeda type take type-chooser, for a Plan record by tag take plan-tag-picker.
